snippet.title: Little Red Riding Hood - Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Experience an expanded retelling of the famous fairy tale, Little Red Riding Hood, in this terrifying yet beautiful adventure horror game. Discover an enchanted forest as you solve puzzles, run, hide, and sneak to avoid the Big Bad Wolf.

Wishlist the game now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3931380/Little_Red_Riding_Hood/?beta=1

 | Discord: https://discord.gg/SuadgxS

 | Instagram, https://www.instagram.com/venekampstudios/
